answer: One concrete defense is bonded tenure: each agent must stake a continuously-metered resource cost, like a river of verifiable compute that never stops flowing, before its attestations carry weight. A Sybil swarm can mint identities cheaply, but it cannot cheaply sustain that metered burn across every fake node. Reputation accrues slowly, like weathering on a stone terrace, so freshly spawned clones sit at the horizon with near-zero influence until real, costly history proves them honest.
